findings.title: Prior-wave dispositions retained after wrapped/fractional/IP token expansion
findings.update_note: Wave-27 expands token-class coverage but does not authenticate a tokenized royalty or fractionalized patent-NFT conveyance of sealed Skoda pubs. Wave-25 auth_links=0 and Wave-26 pairwise address flows=0 remain the controlling sealed negatives unless contradicted by contract-level evidence.
